name: LaTeX 套件
description: 把敲 LaTeX 公式变得和手写一样快。**片段展开**:在公式里打 `@a` 立刻成 `\alpha`、`//` 成分式、`sr` 成平方 —— 上千条打磨过的默认触发串开箱即用,也可以整份换成自己的。**占位跳转**:展开后按 Tab 在 `\frac{}{}`、`\begin{}\end{}` 的空位之间跳,同名占位点自动联动(改一处环境名两头一起变)。**Tabout**:公式里按 Tab 直接跳出括号或跳出 `$`,不用去够方向键。**矩阵快捷**:在 matrix/cases/align 里 Tab 分列、回车换行。**实时符号**:光标不在那一段时 `\alpha` 显示成 α、`\frac{a}{b}` 显示成分式,光标一进就露出源码可编辑。**自动放大括号**:公式里出现 `\sum` 之类的高结构时把括号换成 `\left( \right)`。设置界面自带一个真代码编辑器改片段库,片段也可以放在笔记库的文件/文件夹里由外部编辑器维护、存盘即热重载。全部离线,公式在磁盘上始终是标准 markdown 的 `$…$`,不改任何落盘格式。移植自 Obsidian 的 obsidian-latex-suite(MIT, artisticat1)。
descriptionEn: Make typesetting LaTeX math as fast as handwriting. **Snippets**: type `@a` inside math and get `\alpha`, `//` for fractions, `sr` for squares — a thousand battle-tested triggers out of the box, or swap in your own. **Tabstops**: after expanding, Tab between the empty slots in `\frac{}{}` and `\begin{}\end{}`; repeated slots stay mirrored (rename the environment once, both ends follow). **Tabout**: Tab jumps straight out of brackets or out of `$`. **Matrix shortcuts**: Tab for columns, Enter for rows inside matrix/cases/align. **Conceal**: `\alpha` renders as α while the cursor is elsewhere and reveals the source the moment you move in. **Auto-enlarge brackets** around tall structures. The settings page ships a real code editor for your snippet library, and snippets can live in a vault file or folder that hot-reloads on save. Fully offline; on disk your math stays plain markdown `$…$` — no format changes. Ported from Obsidian's obsidian-latex-suite (MIT, artisticat1).

onboarding.intro: 在成对公式内快速输入 LaTeX。正文自动片段默认关闭，代码区不会展开。

steps.title: 插入公式
steps.description: 在命令面板选择「插入行内公式」或「插入块级公式」，光标会进入成对定界符内。孤立的 $ 不会接管后续正文。

steps.title: 输入与跳位
steps.description: 公式内 @a → \alpha，// → 分式，sr → 平方。Tab 依次处理手动片段、占位点、矩阵分列和跳出公式；Shift+Tab 返回，Esc 结束跳位。

steps.title: 恢复字面输入
steps.description: 刚展开时按 Backspace 还原完整触发串。需要连续输入原文时，在命令面板暂停 LaTeX 自动展开；编辑后使用 Forsion 的撤销。

steps.title: 教程与练习
steps.description: 设置中的「教程与练习」提供真实编辑器和可搜索速查。练习不写入智库。矩阵内 Enter 换行，Shift+Enter 退出环境。

steps.title: 自定义与迁移
steps.description: 片段页支持内置编辑器、文件或文件夹来源。错误时保留有效规则。高级页列出兼容差异，外部文件也可手动重载。

en.intro: Type LaTeX inside paired delimiters. Automatic text snippets are off by default; code is excluded.

steps.title: Insert math
steps.description: Choose Insert inline math or Insert block math from the command palette. A lone dollar sign never captures following prose.

steps.title: Type and navigate
steps.description: Inside math, @a produces \alpha, // a fraction, and sr a square. Tab handles manual snippets, placeholders, matrix cells and exiting math in that order. Shift+Tab goes back; Esc ends the session.

steps.title: Restore literal input
steps.description: Immediately press Backspace to restore the complete trigger. Pause LaTeX automatic expansion from the command palette for literal typing; use Forsion Undo after further edits.

steps.title: Guide and practice
steps.description: Guide & practice provides a real editor and searchable reference without writing to the vault. Enter adds a matrix row; Shift+Enter exits the environment.

steps.title: Customize and migrate
steps.description: Edit snippets in settings or load files or folders. Errors keep working rules. Advanced settings explain compatibility limits; external files can also be reloaded manually.
